import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_trustees_hi_trust_fund_operations.xlsx', sheet_name='HI', header=1)
year_col = df.columns[0]
net_col = [c for c in df.columns if 'Net change' in str(c)][0]
df = df.dropna(subset=[year_col])
df['Year_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df[year_col], errors='coerce')
df_sub = df[(df['Year_num'] >= 2000) & (df['Year_num'] <= 2023)].copy()
df_sub[net_col] = pd.to_numeric(df_sub[net_col], errors='coerce')
min_year = df_sub.loc[df_sub[net_col].idxmin(), 'Year_num']
result = str(int(min_year))

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_trustees_hi_trust_fund_operations.xlsx', sheet_name='HI', header=1)
year_col = df.columns[0]
inc_col = [c for c in df.columns if 'Total' in str(c) and 'income' in str(c)][0]
df['Year_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df[year_col], errors='coerce')
df_sub = df[(df['Year_num'] >= 2015) & (df['Year_num'] <= 2020)].copy()
df_sub[inc_col] = pd.to_numeric(df_sub[inc_col], errors='coerce')
top3 = df_sub.sort_values(by=inc_col, ascending=False).head(3)
result = sorted([str(int(y)) for y in top3['Year_num']])
